---
title: Changing your travel dates
audiences: [ANY]
category: TERMS
phrasings:
  - can I move my trip to another date
  - reschedule departure
  - postpone holiday
  - change dates
---

A date change is free until 45 days before departure, subject to availability. Later changes cost 50 euro per person plus any fare difference. Flights already ticketed follow the airline's own change rules.
